GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 614.32 (3 Mar 47) DS
(SCAPIN-1552)
APO 500
3 March 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Recovery of Chinese Nationality by Japanese Subjects of Chinese Origin
1. Reference Memorandum from the Imperial Japanese Government, C. L. O NO. 6202 (PP - HW - J), 22 November 1946, subject as above.
2. There is no objection to the Imperial Japanese Government requiring that certificates concerning Chinese nationality status issued by a competent agensy of the Chinese Government accompany notifications of loss of Japanese nationality given to Japanese registry offices by previously naturalized Japanese subjects of Chinese origin.
3. The Chinese Mission in Japan is the proper agency of the Chinese Government to issue such certificates.
4. There is no objection to direct contacts in this regard between Japanese subjects of Chinese origin and the Chinese Mission in Japan.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
